name.value: Spruce Grove RV Park and Campground

description.value: A full-service RV-style campground on the banks of the Columbia River, five minutes from Fairmont Hot Springs Resort's natural mineral pools — an ideal rest stop for tired legs, though hot-spring entry carries an extra fee.

address.value: Spruce Grove Frontage Road, Fairmont Hot Springs, V0B 1L1

raw_osm.name: Spruce Grove RV Park and Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a large RV park and campground (137 sites) on the Columbia River near Fairmont Hot Springs Resort. Showers are confirmed by 'Washrooms with hot showers and flush toilets.' Laundry is confirmed by 'Coin operated laundromat.' Ice is confirmed by 'Ice, camping accessories and firewood available at campground store.' Animal-safe food storage is supported by 'Bear safe garbage bins provided throughout the park.' The website mentions a 'reservation holder' in its policies, confirming reservations are accepted. Food nearby is confirmed via 'many dining locations' at the nearby resort. No hiker/biker sites or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website lists 250.345.6561 and toll-free 1.800.663.4979 (opt 6)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-equipped campground accepting tents along the Columbia River valley cycling corridor, with showers, laundry, a store, and proximity to resort amenities. Suitable for touring cyclists passing through the East Kootenay region.

wow_evidence: washrooms with hot showers and flush toilets… coin operated laundromat… five minutes from Fairmont Hot Springs Resort's natural mineral pools
